paper_title: Bridging Cognition and Emotion Empathy-Driven Multimodal Misinformation   Detection
caption: Results of Ablation Study
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the results of an ablation study by displaying the Accuracy (%) of various model configurations across two distinct datasets, labeled "PHEME" and "PolitiFact" in large text at the top of the chart. The vertical value axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" and uses a linear scale ranging from a baseline value of 75.0 up to 95.0, with horizontal dashed gridlines aligned at numeric tick label intervals of 2.5. The horizontal category axis lacks a overarching title but is divided into two side-by-side panels separated by a vertical dashed line, each containing a sequence of six rotated category labels: "Ours", "w/o comments", "w/o text", "w/o select", "w/o emotion", and "w/o cognition". The bars are grouped side-by-side within each panel, outlined in black, and maintain a consistent color mapping across both datasets. The "Ours" category is represented by a dark red bar, "w/o comments" is orange, "w/o text" is light yellow, "w/o select" is light blue, "w/o emotion" is medium blue, and "w/o cognition" is dark blue. Each bar is visually emphasized with a bold numerical annotation positioned directly above it indicating its exact value. Across the entire chart, the shortest bar is the light yellow "w/o text" category in the PHEME panel, annotated with a value of 80.10, while the tallest bar is the dark red "Ours" category in the PolitiFact panel, annotated at 90.57. Within the PHEME section, the values for the remaining categories are 89.84 for "Ours", 86.82 for "w/o comments", 88.80 for "w/o select", 87.34 for "w/o emotion", and 87.17 for "w/o cognition". In the PolitiFact section, the corresponding remaining values are 85.85 for "w/o comments", 83.02 for "w/o text", 89.62 for "w/o select", 84.91 for "w/o emotion", and 87.74 for "w/o cognition". The bars are not sorted alphabetically or by magnitude, but rather follow the same categorical sequence from left to right within both dataset groupings.
